Yes, provided a data-sharing agreement is in place, because an account's administrators can open every case held under it.

Owing to the sensitive nature of what an Advanced case holds, access is granted per case to named people and to nobody else by default. The [Standard plan's answer](./can-two-teams-share-one-account-standard-plan.md) describes the looser default that applies there.

This answer is for the [Advanced plan](../tiers/advanced-plan.md).
